layout.postureText: Identity, governance, evidence and runtime protection are presented as one control plane.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.consoleTitle: A single control plane for LLM security, governance and audit evidence.
dashboard.consoleSubtitle: ShadowAI now presents itself as what the backend already is: an enterprise security console for controlled LLM adoption.

protect.title: Runtime LLM Firewall
protect.body: Streaming inspection, sanitize/block outcomes, semantic shadow rollout and audit-ready policy decisions.

govern.title: Provider and budget control
govern.body: Per-org allowlists, role/context scoped routing, department sensitivity and aggregate org budget caps.
govern.signal: Policy cache and org isolation enabled

evidence.title: Tamper-evident audit chain
evidence.body: HMAC chain, Merkle anchors, Ed25519 manifests, Object Lock bundles and offline auditor verification.

operate.title: Identity and production controls
operate.body: OIDC, SCIM, admin MFA, break-glass, production validation and evidence collection runbooks.

dashboard.trafficSubtitle: Existing dashboard data, now framed as control-plane signal
dashboard.maskedIdentityNote: PII-minimized: masked email + stable user id

signals.blockRateDetail: Derived from total and blocked request counters.
signals.siemDetail: Async batching, retry and backpressure controls are implemented.
signals.streamingDetail: Incremental mode remains gated by proof-window criteria.

evidence.title: Chain-of-custody evidence for auditors and operators.
evidence.subtitle: This view shows how ShadowAI turns audit rows into verifiable evidence bundles: HMAC chain, Merkle anchors, signed manifests, independent sinks and Object Lock retention.

db.label: DB tamper detection
db.detail: Gaps or row rewrites are detected by the verifier through seq_no and HMAC continuity.

external.label: External witness
external.detail: Anchors are signed and published to file/immudb/additional sinks for an independent witness layer.

bundle.label: Portable auditor bundle
bundle.detail: Global and tenant bundles verify offline without live DB access; tenant bundles do not expose cross-tenant row hashes.

chain.title: Hash chain on audit tables
chain.body: All critical audit tables receive seq_no and row_hash; verifier catches gaps and chain breaks.

anchors.title: Signed Merkle anchors
anchors.body: The scheduler builds Merkle roots over row_hash ranges and signs manifests with an Ed25519 key id.

sinks.title: Independent witness sinks
sinks.body: Primary sink keeps backward compatibility; W8 additional sinks surface degraded posture on partial failure.

objectLock.title: S3 Object Lock retention
objectLock.body: Evidence export uploads only verified bundles; Object Lock mode/retention/hold are checked by the report CLI.

bundle.title: Offline evidence bundle
bundle.body: Bundle contains manifest hashes, anchors, chain inventory or tenant Merkle proofs and public key.

validation.title: Production go/no-go validation
validation.body: PROD1 ties live rollout, readiness, bundle verification and retention posture into one report.

evidence.pipelineTitle: From audit row to portable bundle
evidence.pipelineNote: This diagram shows the capability contract. Operators run the commands below and archive output for live evidence.

rows.title: Audit rows
rows.body: Proxy, admin, legal hold and purge events are written into scoped tables.

chain.title: HMAC continuity
chain.body: Row hash links the current canonical row with the previous tip.

merkle.title: Merkle range
merkle.body: Anchor root covers a contiguous seq_no range.

sign.title: Signed manifest
sign.body: Ed25519 signature covers sink_ref and anchor fields.

sink.title: Witness sinks
sink.body: file/immudb/additional sinks receive one signed manifest.

bundle.title: Auditor bundle
bundle.body: Offline verifier checks signatures, hashes, ranges and proofs.

evidence.commandsTitle: Checks that produce real evidence artifacts
evidence.operatorTitle: What the UI must not overpromise

notLive.title: This is not live monitoring
notLive.body: UX2 shows the implemented control model. Actual status comes from CLI reports, CronJob status and Prometheus alerts.

independentSink.title: Second sink is configuration-dependent
independentSink.body: W8 supports additional sinks, but regulated deployments must explicitly configure an independent witness.

restoreDrill.title: Restore drill remains operator-owned
restoreDrill.body: The command is automated, but scheduling, execution and evidence retention remain an operational control.

tenants.title: Tenant control plane for organization isolation, SCIM onboarding and org-level guardrails.
tenants.subtitle: This view documents the implemented multi-tenant governance model: org_id runtime boundary, per-org SCIM tokens, scoped evidence bundles, tenant purge and aggregate budget caps.

boundary.title: Runtime org boundary
boundary.body: User-facing, audit, governance and internal DB queries are scoped by org_id from authenticated claims. JWT is not treated as source of truth without DB resolution.
boundary.artifact: Artifact: scoped repositories, org_id columns, tenant smoke tests

scim.title: Per-org SCIM provisioning
scim.body: A SCIM bearer token resolves to org_id; externalId and email-link lookup happen inside that organization.

budget.title: Aggregate org budget caps
budget.body: Org budget checks aggregate user spend for the organization and uses atomic reservation in enforce mode.

evidence.title: Tenant evidence without cross-tenant hashes
evidence.body: Tenant bundle exports only org rows and Merkle subset proofs, not the full global chain inventory.

global.title: Global admin workflows
global.body: global_admin manages organizations and SCIM tokens, while source_org_id/target_org_id are written to the admin evidence trail.

purge.title: Scoped purge controls
purge.body: Tenant purge requires explicit --org-id; global purge requires --all-orgs. Unsafe implicit scope is rejected.

tenants.flowTitle: How an organization moves from creation to auditor export

create.title: Create organization
create.body: global_admin creates the org and receives a machine-readable admin event with target_org_id.

provision.title: SCIM provisioning
provision.body: The IdP uses an org-bound token; deprovision bumps token_version and invalidates sessions.

govern.title: Governance and budget
govern.body: Per-org provider policy, context scoped routing and budget caps are enforced on the proxy hot path.

export.title: Tenant evidence export
export.body: The auditor receives a tenant bundle with Merkle proofs and an explicit scope disclaimer.

tenants.commandsTitle: Commands that produce real tenant artifacts

manage.accessTitle: Tenant control is available only to admin/global_admin
manage.accessBody: Regular users cannot manage organizations, SCIM tokens or org budgets. The UI hides actions fail-safe, while the backend remains source of truth.
manage.orgsBody: global_admin sees every organization. Tenant admin loads only its own org_id from authenticated claims.
manage.name: Name
manage.selectOrg: Select an organization to manage SCIM tokens and org budget.

scim.title: SCIM bearer tokens
scim.body: The token is bound to an organization through scim_tokens. Plaintext is shown only once after creation.
scim.label: Label
scim.oneTimeBody: Copy the token into the IdP now. After this message is cleared, the frontend cannot show it again.
scim.revokeConfirm: Revoke this SCIM token? IdP provisioning with this token will stop working.

budget.title: Aggregate spend cap
budget.body: The cap applies to aggregate user spend for the organization. In enforce mode the proxy atomically reserves budget before the provider call.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
errors.conflict: Data conflict: slug or identity is already in use.
errors.missingOrg: JWT claims do not contain org_id. Tenant admin UI cannot determine the own organization.

messages.tokenCreated: SCIM token created. Plaintext is shown once.

compliance.title: Compliance workspace for SOC2/ISO evidence, access review and retention reports.
compliance.subtitle: This is not a certification or legal opinion. The view shows which packages, reports and runbooks already exist for auditor workflow and security questionnaires.
compliance.disclaimer: ShadowAI can collect evidence artifacts and control mappings, but final attestation remains with the auditor/customer. The UI must not claim SOC2/ISO certification.

mapping.title: SOC2 / ISO control mapping
mapping.body: The document maps implemented controls to auditor-facing evidence and honestly lists remaining gaps.

collect.title: Quarterly evidence package
collect.body: The collector gathers a control snapshot, retention report, chain verify summary, access review and not_collected reasons.

access.title: Privileged access review
access.body: The report surfaces global_admin, org_admin, admins without MFA, break-glass and unlinked privileged users.

validation.title: Production validation pack
validation.body: Go/no-go reporting combines Helm render, readiness, evidence verification, CronJob posture and Object Lock configuration.

vendor.title: Vendor governance response
vendor.body: Security questionnaire language separates implemented controls from roadmap gaps and prevents overclaiming.

gaps.title: Current gaps are explicit
gaps.body: Pen test, customer-specific SAML deltas, broader BYOK epochs and external auditor execution remain separate work items.

compliance.packageTitle: What goes into the evidence collection bundle
compliance.commandsTitle: Commands for the quarterly evidence cycle

operations.title: Operations cockpit for production readiness, restore drills, SIEM delivery and BYOK rollout.
operations.subtitle: This view does not show live health. It collects operating procedures that turn backend controls into a repeatable production process.

validation.title: Go / no-go validation
validation.body: The production validation pack checks config, Helm, readiness, evidence and critical CronJob/alert assumptions before rollout.

siem.title: SIEM delivery posture
siem.body: Async batching, retry, backpressure and delivery metrics reduce operational risk around admin/security event delivery.

restore.title: Restore drill with keyrings
restore.body: The W7 key epoch model verifies chain, anchors and signatures after restore without depending on one legacy key.

byok.title: BYOK audit payload rollout
byok.body: Vault Transit encrypts new audit request/response payloads; legacy rows are handled by the sweep command.

preflight.title: Preflight validation
preflight.body: Before deploy, operators run the render/validation pack and check secrets, prod gates and evidence storage prerequisites.

deploy.title: Deploy and observe
deploy.body: Helm rollout uses probes, PDB/HPA and Prometheus alerts; streaming incremental remains gated until the proof-window is complete.

evidence.title: Evidence automation
evidence.body: CronJobs export bundles, verify them offline and publish them to PVC/S3 with retention controls.

archive.title: Quarterly archive
archive.body: Compliance package, access review and retention report are archived as auditor-ready artifacts.

settings.title: Settings & Admin Control Center for production posture without exposing secrets.
settings.subtitle: A read-only view connecting runtime signals, configuration checklists and operator next steps. It does not mutate env settings and does not show green status when no backend signal exists.
settings.boundaryText: Settings in this release show posture and verification sources. Secrets, tokens, API keys and KMS credentials are not displayed or edited from the browser.
settings.liveTitle: Only endpoints with real backend signals

readiness.title: DB / Redis readiness
readiness.ok: DB and Redis are reachable; service can accept traffic.
readiness.unknown: Readiness signal is unavailable from the frontend.

firewall.title: Inspector runtime status
firewall.disabled: Firewall endpoint is reachable, but pipeline reports disabled.
firewall.unknown: Firewall status is unavailable or the user lacks admin access.

audit.title: Audit privacy / purge posture
audit.ok: Payload mode: {mode}; retention: {days} days; purged rows total: {purged}.
audit.unknown: Audit status is unavailable or the user lacks admin access.

providers.title: Provider connectivity snapshot
providers.none: Provider registry is empty or connectivity snapshot has not been created.
providers.unknown: Provider connectivity is unavailable or the user lacks admin access.

identity.title: Identity controls
identity.body: OIDC, SCIM, MFA, break-glass and token invalidation are governed by backend config and dedicated auth endpoints. UX4 shows the control family without exposing secrets.

siem.title: SIEM delivery
siem.body: Async SIEM queue, retry, backpressure and delivery metrics are production controls. They are shown as a checklist until a dedicated status API exists.
siem.source: Check: SIEM env, Prometheus alerts, admin events

evidence.title: Evidence / WORM
evidence.body: HMAC chain, Merkle anchors, signed manifests, additional sinks and Object Lock are verified through CLI/CronJob reports, not browser secret config.
evidence.source: Check: audit-verify, evidence export, retention report

streaming.title: Streaming / firewall gates
streaming.body: Incremental streaming promotion remains gated. Settings shows the operator boundary; the actual decision requires F7.6 proof-window metrics.

byok.title: BYOK audit payloads
byok.body: BYOK uses Vault Transit for audit request/response payloads. Vault endpoint/token are never displayed in the UI.

production.title: Production validation
production.body: Go/no-go status is produced by the production validation pack, Helm render, smoke and evidence checks. UI does not replace the release gate.

settings.noSecretsTitle: What this view intentionally does not show

items.apiKeys: Provider API keys, SIEM tokens, SCIM bearer tokens and break-glass secret hashes.
items.tokens: OIDC client secrets, JWT signing secret, audit chain secret and signing private keys.
items.endpoints: Sensitive KMS/Vault credentials and internal service tokens.
items.runtime: Editable env/config mutations from the browser are a separate audited workflow, not UX4.

tenant.title: UX5 Tenant Admin
tenant.body: Organizations, SCIM tokens and org budgets become interactive instead of overview-only.

auth.title: UX6 Auth UX
auth.body: MFA challenge/setup, OIDC login, break-glass and profile security are aligned with the backend contract.

ops.title: UX10 Live operations
ops.body: Operations and dashboard get an honest split between live metrics and static capability posture.
